linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectSound-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: None (not VR-compatible)
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectSound-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: None (not VR-compatible)
